capture_source: live capture 2026-09-30 against a HoneySAP endpoint on gateway port 3300, from the saprfclib system-info run (frame 19). It is the reply to RFC_GET_STRUCTURE_DEFINITION(TABNAME=RFCSI): return code 0 but no FIELDS table at all. Sanitised preserving byte length: GW conversation handle at [40:48] zeroed and 16-byte 0x0514 session token zeroed. No NI length prefix.
evidence: 0x0420 == 0 (success) yet the TLV stream carries no 0x0301 'FIELDS' table and no 0x0302/0x0305 records, so _parse_dfies_rows and _parse_ddif_dfies_rows both yield zero rows. This is why saprfclib produced 'no DFIES rows'/type_desc None until it was taught to resolve DDIC layout via DDIF_FIELDINFO_GET.

field_annotations.name: gw_frame_type
field_annotations.note: GW/RFC data frame type; 80-byte GW header precedes the TLV stream.

notes: This endpoint answers RFC_GET_STRUCTURE_DEFINITION with an empty success, whereas it answers DDIF_FIELDINFO_GET (the reference library's DDIC-layout RFC) with the real field rows. Used to exercise the DDIF -> RFC_GET_STRUCTURE_DEFINITION fallback: when DDIF yields nothing the code falls back, and when the fallback is also empty it raises 'no DFIES rows'.
